headline: French Unions Protest Rising Cost of Living
summary: French unions are protesting against the rising cost of living, warning that the country is on the verge of recession and fearing widespread job cuts.
why: France is the second-largest economy in the Eurozone. Widespread labor unrest and recession fears can impact consumer spending, business investment, and government policy.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Labor unrest can disrupt economic activity and pressure government policy.
